description: Minister-Approved Major Transit Station Areas is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. Chapter 8 of Toronto’s Official Plan contains policies and delineations for Major Transit Station Areas and Protected Major Transit Station areas. The delineations for these areas are set out in Map 1 of the policy for each station, respectively. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. It offers 2 resource(s) in XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-02-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
